_comment: Rows of harness/captures/out2/deltav_readout.json excluded from the capture.ship_construct gate, one by one, each with its reason (README "Golden gate options", STATUS.md WP-18). Only data that a package other than ShipConstruct produces belongs here: the one fairing of the 17 crafts (ModuleProceduralFairing.panelMass is the mass of the built fairing panels, WP-26).

craft.reason: craft_ComSat_Lx contains fairingSize1 (part 10): its module mass is ModuleProceduralFairing.panelMass (ModuleProceduralFairing.cs:1663, Mathf.Clamp(panelMass, Mathf.Epsilon, Mathf.Abs(panelMass))), the mass of the fairing panels the module builds from its xSection nodes (FairingPanel mesh generation, WP-26). Until WP-26 panelMass is 0 and the module mass is Mathf.Epsilon. The craft's dry_mass includes it; the other 16 crafts and the other 17 parts of this craft are exact.

parts.reason: fairingSize1: mass and module_mass include ModuleProceduralFairing.panelMass (panels of the built fairing, WP-26); see craft_ComSat_Lx in the craft table.
